description: A data de emissão da DPS deve ser anterior ou igual à data e hora do seu processamento (dhProc) pelo Sistema Nacional NFS-e.
timezone_schema: tiposSimples_v1.01.xsd / TSDateTimeUTC accepts an explicit TZD. Schema hashes in homologation-20261020.provenance.json.
application_policy: Serialize the current instant in America/Sao_Paulo with its explicit offset, truncating milliseconds only. Do not change competence, invent dhProc, subtract a safety interval, or rewrite a signed historical request.
limits: The reported E0008 proves the rejection code, not the underlying cause of the temporal comparison. Previous XML used UTC +00:00. Equal instants in UTC and Sao Paulo should compare equally in a timezone-aware service. The first response processing timestamp and success-field nullability were not retained and cannot be inferred from the code alone.
